_note: Diagnostic test catalog used by the adaptive-testing engine. 'resolves' lists the uncertainty sources a test addresses; 'overrides' lists features whose new measurement replaces earlier evidence. Hardware execution must be enforced by the rig's own protection (BMS, fuse, thermal cut-off) — the AI only requests tests.

tests.name: Pulse Discharge Test
tests.description: Rest, then a 2C current pulse for 20 s and 30 s relaxation. Measures DC internal resistance and voltage recovery.

tests.name: Full Capacity Discharge
tests.description: Full CC discharge at 0.5C from full charge to cut-off with rests before and after. Direct capacity measurement.

tests.name: Thermal Observation Run
tests.description: 1C discharge segment with temperature logging at 1 Hz to characterise heating per unit load.

tests.name: OCV Relaxation Check
tests.description: Short discharge followed by a 20 min rest to read relaxed open-circuit voltage (SOC window anchor).

tests.name: Cell Balance Scan
tests.description: Per-cell voltage measurement via balance taps under load. Requires cell-tap wiring on the rig.

tests.name: Extended Charge/Discharge Cycle
tests.description: Full charge + full discharge with rests. Measures coulombic efficiency and adds an ageing-trend point.

ir_missing.message: Internal resistance behaviour is insufficiently characterised (no load step / pulse in the data).

power_uncertain.message: Power capability is inferred, not measured — it decides between high-power and energy applications.

capacity_window.message: Only a narrow SOC window was discharged, so usable capacity is extrapolated.

soh_interval_wide.message: The SOH prediction interval is wide relative to application thresholds.

no_rest.message: No relaxation period after load — end-of-test OCV/SOC anchor is missing.

temp_missing.message: No temperature data — thermal behaviour and safety margin cannot be assessed.

thermal_uncertain.message: Temperature rise was measured over too little load to characterise heating.

imbalance_missing.message: Per-cell voltages were not measured — cell imbalance unknown.

rul_history_short.message: Too few ageing points for a battery-specific degradation fit (population prior used).

efficiency_unmeasured.message: Round-trip efficiency is estimated from resistance, not measured.

ood.message: Measurements fall outside the model's training distribution.
